question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84fb3279d9acec11c56b74aae9bb81440bdbfbfb118ccfe5281b2ea16efb26b4.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

From the given three different cubes, figure 1 and figure 3, the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 1 is common in both figure 1 and figure 2, it is clear that 3, 4, 5 and 6 are adjacent to it, and the remaining number i.e., 2 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7606d79a9343cb680f9a78347d24c6448e38dd206008645c90af493b091ef0a1.png] 

Opposite pairs:

3 → 5

4 → 6

1 → 2

So, the opposite side of "1" will be side "2".

Hence, the correct answer is "2".
